day_shape: Houthi seizure of Yemen's Mocha port and advance on Bab al-Mandab dominates, IRGC claims strike on US Saildrone in Hormuz, UK/Quad table IAEA Iran resolution at UNSC with Russia and China objecting, two arrested in London over suspected Iran-linked intelligence activity.

threads.label: Houthi advance on Yemen's western coast
threads.summary: Houthis seized the Red Sea port of Mocha and pushed toward Bab al-Mandab, with Iran International, Jerusalem Post and Defa Press reporting takeover of Hais, Khokha and the Hanish islands. Defa Press claimed complete control of Bab al-Mandab and the al-Omari base; Jerusalem Post cited Yemeni sources alleging Quds Force involvement and IRGC-drafted phased plans.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz Saildrone claim
threads.summary: IRGC Navy commander Azamayee said Sepah Navy struck a US Saildrone unmanned vessel (hull 5838) at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, declaring the strait 'closed' and under Iranian control. CENTCOM separately said US forces had redirected 96 commercial vessels enforcing a blockade against Iran, and the Jerusalem Post reported Trump proposed renaming the strait after himself.

threads.label: Iran nuclear file at UNSC and IAEA
threads.summary: The UK, France, Germany and US tabled a Quad resolution at the IAEA Board on Iran's NPT safeguards, and Ambassador Sarah MacIntosh delivered a UK statement at the UN Security Council 1737 Committee briefing. Russia and China objected to the session; Jerusalem Post cited IAEA chief Grossi on satellite imagery of construction at Iran's Pickaxe Mountain site and reported Iran had resumed ballistic missile production from existing components.

threads.label: UK arrests over suspected Iran intelligence links
threads.summary: UK counter-terrorism police arrested two people in London on suspicion of assisting a foreign intelligence service in a case linked to Iran, under the National Security Act. Iran International also reported Singapore's ISD said an Iraqi Iran-backed militia commander applied three times to visit the city-state.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas operatives in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Israeli security bodies confirmed the killing of Hamas West Bank military council member Farah Hamed in a Gaza City strike, and Nukhba operative Ismail Ibrahim Darwish Qandil in a Khan Younis strike. The IDF also announced the apprehension of Ismail Ankaio in Beitunia and a strike in Beit Lahia that Palestinian media said killed four family members.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressures and infiltration bill row
threads.summary: Iran International reported a clash between Pezeshkian's cabinet and parliament over a foreign 'infiltration' bill, alongside rising food prices, protester injuries, and Tehran's governor seeking return of schools used by military forces. Regime channels carried Central Bank governor Hemati calling US pressure a 'miscalculation' and parliament speaker Qalibaf pointing to Brent above $105.

threads.label: Regional humanitarian and civilian toll
threads.summary: UNHCR's Emergency Update #23 said hostilities in Iran and Lebanon since late February 2026 have generated humanitarian consequences and refugee returns to Afghanistan and Syria. Iran International reported US warplanes were damaged by Iranian missiles at a base in Jordan, and Human Rights Watch said Hezbollah's cluster munitions use in northern Israel may have constituted a war crime.

events.summary: An Iranian protester shot in the leg during January’s demonstrations remains unable to walk after 23 operations, with further treatment ahead, medical bills mounting and concerns for his safety persisting months after the shooting.

events.title: WFP welcomes Japan's USD 2 million emergency contribution for families affected by conflict in Iran
events.summary: TEHRAN, Iran – The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) welcomes a USD 2 million emergency contribution from the Government of Japan to provide life-saving food assistance to vulnerable families affected by the recent conflict in Iran. The contribution will enable WFP to support 147,000 people, equivalent to 36,750 households, with emergency food assistance covering 30 days of basic food need…

events.title: Iran routed up to $2.5 billion via China sanctions workaround in past year - Reuters
events.summary: Iran routed an estimated $2 billion to $2.5 billion through a China-based trade mechanism over the past year, using proceeds from oil sales to pay for Chinese goods and, at least once, contracts for military equipment, Reuters reported on Thursday.
